Game Overview

In Quick Throw, the core idea is straightforward: rush against time in Quick Throw, where rock-paper-scissors evolves into a high-speed challenge. Face an unending flow of opponent moves and react instantly to outsmart them. Perfect your timing and elevate your score, while your reflexes are pushed to their limits in this exciting test of wits.
